title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the "Opinion on Further Strengthening Anti-Corruption and Integrity Building in the People's Courts"
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Opinions on Further Strengthening the Anti-Corruption Construction of People's Courts"

Fa Fa [2008] No. 39

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The "Opinions on Further Strengthening the Anti-Corruption Construction of People's Courts" of the Supreme People's Court are hereby issued to you. Please implement them in light of actual work. Report any issues encountered during implementation to the Supreme People's Court in a timely manner.

This document is also being sent to the Party committees and the Party committee political and legal affairs committees of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; please forward it on our behalf.

December 5, 2008

Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Further Strengthening the Anti-Corruption Construction of People's Courts

In recent years, people's courts at all levels have held high the great banner of socialism with Chinese characteristics, adhered to the guidance of Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of "Three Represents," thoroughly implemented the Scientific Outlook on Development, persisted in the anti-corruption policy of addressing both symptoms and root causes, comprehensive measures, combining punishment with prevention, and focusing on prevention, and earnestly implemented various work deployments of the Supreme People's Court on strengthening the anti-corruption construction of people's courts. The construction of a system for punishing and preventing corruption in people's courts has been vigorously strengthened, and the Party conduct, integrity, and anti-corruption efforts of people's courts have achieved significant results. The judicial integrity awareness of the vast majority of judicial police has been further enhanced, their ability to resist temptation and erosion has been continuously improved. Facing heavy work tasks, they have been conscientious, dedicated, and selfless, striving to do a good job in adjudication, enforcement, and other work of the courts, making important contributions to promoting economic and social development, maintaining social stability and social harmony. They are a strong team loyal to the Party, the country, the people, and the law. However, we must also clearly recognize that China is in a critical period of reform and development, social ideology and culture exhibit the characteristics of diversity, variety, and changeability, the independence, selectivity, variability, and difference of people's ideological activities are constantly increasing, and the influence and erosion of various negative factors on the judge team are relatively serious. Cases of a small number of judges seriously violating discipline and law still occur from time to time, especially a very small number of court leading cadres who take bribes and pervert the law, engage in malpractice for personal gain, and become morally degenerate, seriously damaging the image of courts and judges in the eyes of the people, undermining judicial authority and judicial credibility, and causing very serious consequences.

People's courts are an important part of the state apparatus of the people's democratic dictatorship in China, are the adjudication organs of the state, and bear major political and social responsibilities for consolidating the Party's ruling position, maintaining the long-term stability of the country, ensuring the people's peaceful life, and promoting sound and rapid economic and social development. Leading cadres at all levels of the courts and the vast majority of judicial police should take the Scientific Outlook on Development as guidance, effectively grasp, tighten, and do a good job in the construction of Party conduct, integrity, and anti-corruption work in the courts as a matter of vital importance to the rise and fall of the people's judicial cause, continuously eradicate the soil and conditions that breed corruption, and provide strong political and disciplinary guarantees for implementing the guiding ideology of "Three Supremes," the work thinking of "Six Adherences, Six Guarantees," and the work policy of "Strictly Governing the Courts, Establishing Credibility, Strengthening the Courts with Science and Technology," in order to ensure fair, efficient, and clean justice.

I. Unremittingly Strengthen Anti-Corruption Education

Education is the foundational work of anti-corruption construction and the ideological guarantee for resisting corruption and preventing degeneration. Courts at all levels should closely combine the actual work of their region and unit with the ideological reality of their judicial police, highlight the focus of education, enrich the content of education, innovate the methods of education, and improve the effectiveness of education, so that the vast majority of judicial police can withstand the severe test of corruption and anti-corruption under market economy conditions and build a solid ideological and moral line of defense against corruption and degeneration.

1. The socialist core value system should be placed in the primary position of judicial integrity education, forming a unified guiding ideology, common ideals and beliefs, strong spiritual strength, and good moral standards throughout the system. Emphasis should be placed on leading cadres at all levels of the courts, and education on the Party's purpose and the concept of power should be further strengthened, so that leading cadres at all levels and the vast majority of judicial police always keep in mind that the judicial power in their hands is entrusted by the people, can only be used to serve the people, and must never be used for personal gain.

2. In-depth typical demonstration education should be carried out to enhance the appeal of education, especially using typical negative cases that occur around judicial police to educate the vast majority of judicial police. Every court should write a summary report on conducting warning education, and every judicial police officer should write reflections on receiving warning education, so as to constantly cultivate the virtue of governance, constantly reflect on the harm of greed, and constantly maintain self-discipline.

3. Judicial integrity education should be combined with the education and training of court judicial police, incorporating judicial integrity education into the plan for professional training of judges. The normal mechanism for judicial integrity education should be further improved, with emphasis on strengthening education for court judicial police "before taking office," "before taking up a post," "before handling a case," and "before holidays."

4. More colorful, more vibrant, and more court-specific integrity culture creation activities should be vigorously carried out. While continuously meeting the growing spiritual and cultural needs of the vast majority of judicial police, a better cultural environment for fair, efficient, and clean justice in people's courts should be created.

II. Unremittingly Strengthen the Construction of Anti-Corruption Systems

Systems are fundamental, comprehensive, stable, and long-term, and play an important guarantee role in anti-corruption construction. System construction should be run through all aspects of anti-corruption work in people's courts and reflected in all aspects. By establishing, completing, and resolutely implementing various systems, a mechanism should be formed that uses systems to regulate the professional conduct of judges and other staff, handles affairs according to systems, and manages people by systems, continuously improving the institutionalization and legalization level of anti-corruption in people's courts.

1. In response to outstanding issues affecting judicial integrity in adjudication and enforcement work, binding regulations on judge conduct and corresponding handling measures should be formulated, and at the same time, made public to society. Through encouraging parties and the general public to report and carrying out open and covert inspections, problems should be discovered in a timely manner. Persons who dare to violate the above regulations should be strictly dealt with according to the regulations. Those who are unsuitable to continue engaging in adjudication or enforcement work should be resolutely transferred from their posts. If the circumstances are serious, they should be resolutely dealt with according to discipline and law, so as to ensure orders are carried out and prohibitions are effective, and to win the trust of the people.

2. System regulations for regulating the relationship between judges and lawyers and personnel of intermediary institutions should be further improved, and a reporting system for the employment status of spouses and children of court staff, an internal publicity system, and a recusal system for taking up posts should be established and completed.

3. A pre-case reporting system for adjudication and enforcement staff to implement the recusal system should be established, along with a reporting and publicity system for cases involving entrustment and intercession, and the procedures for court leading cadres to exercise case management and supervision powers should be standardized, specifying the scope of authority and procedural regulations for transmitting materials outside the case handling process. At the same time, court staff who fail to report relevant circumstances according to regulations, or who engage in mutual entrustment and intercession, make informal contacts, or transmit materials outside normal procedures within the court, shall be dealt with as disciplinary violations.

III. Unremittingly Strengthen Supervision Over the Exercise of Power

Strengthening supervision over the exercise of judicial management power, adjudication power, and enforcement power is a key link in effectively preventing corruption in people's courts. Courts at all levels should effectively increase the intensity of supervision over leading bodies, leading cadres, key departments, and critical positions.

1. In terms of supervising leading bodies and leading cadres, supervision should focus on the power of case approval, case supervision, cadre appointment, fund management, and project contracting; in terms of supervising criminal adjudication power, supervision should focus on the application of probation, commutation, parole, and temporary service of sentence outside prison; in terms of supervising civil and commercial adjudication power and administrative adjudication power, supervision should focus on the links of retrial case filing, property preservation, collegial panel decision, and mediation and settlement; in terms of supervising enforcement power, supervision should focus on the links of entrusted evaluation, auction, sale, adoption and lifting of enforcement measures, addition of persons subject to enforcement, and suspension and termination.

2. Supervision over the implementation of systems should be strengthened, and a system implementation mechanism with "clear powers and responsibilities, standardized procedures, effective supervision, and strong guarantees" should be established to ensure the implementation of various systems. Acts of disregarding orders, defying prohibitions, and intentionally undermining systems should be dealt with seriously according to discipline and law.

3. Various supervision resources should be integrated, and relevant coordination and linkage mechanisms should be established, combining internal supervision of people's courts with external supervision such as supervision by the People's Congress, democratic supervision by the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, procuratorial supervision, and public opinion supervision; combining supervision by the discipline inspection and supervision departments of people's courts with supervision by the petition reception departments, case evaluation departments, inspection and supervision departments, and supervision by the presidents of courts and division heads over collegial panels and sole judges, forming a supervision network that combines internal and external, interacts at all levels, reaches vertically to the end, and extends horizontally to all sides, ensuring the correct exercise of judicial management power, adjudication power, and enforcement power.

IV. Unremittingly Explore Reform Measures to Prevent and Control Corruption at the Source

Emancipating the mind, updating concepts, and using development ideas and reform methods to solve new situations and problems arising in the anti-corruption construction of people's courts are effective ways to prevent judicial corruption at the source and also an inexhaustible driving force for continuously advancing the anti-corruption construction of people's courts. Courts at all levels should closely combine the ongoing judicial system and working mechanism reform, focus on standardizing the exercise of power, take openness and transparency as the basic requirement, and actively explore reform measures to prevent and control corruption at the source.

1. The allocation of powers and functions within people's courts should be optimized, a more scientific trial-level management system should be established, a power supervision mechanism with "reasonable structure, scientific allocation, strict procedures, and effective checks and balances" should be constructed, and the funding guarantee system for people's courts should be improved. Unified adjudication standards for criminal, civil and commercial, and administrative cases should be improved, and the discretionary power of judges should be standardized; the case handling process for enforcement cases should be improved, and an enforcement working mechanism with separation of powers and checks and balances should be established.

2. The system of openness in adjudication and enforcement should be improved and perfected, channels for openness should be broadened, the scope of openness should be expanded, systems for online publication of judgment documents and inquiry of enforcement case information should be established, and openness in case filing, court hearings, evidence adoption, fact finding, judgment reasoning and results, enforcement process, and case handling discipline should be fully implemented, placing adjudication and enforcement activities to the greatest extent under the supervision of litigants and all sectors of society.

3. A system for regular exchange of internal staff of people's courts, especially members of collegial panels, and a system for timely replacement of case handlers who may affect fair adjudication and lawful enforcement should be established. A system for establishing part-time supervisors in each business department of people's courts should be explored and established, the inspection and supervision system, case quality evaluation system, and case trial period supervision system of people's courts should be improved, and a responsibility tracing mechanism for litigation-related petition cases should be perfected. The performance evaluation mechanism of people's courts should be improved, and an integrity file system for court leading cadres and a judicial file system for law enforcement and case handling personnel should be established.

V. Unremittingly Investigate and Handle Cases of Disciplinary and Legal Violations

Strengthening punishment for acts of disciplinary and legal violations and corruption, forming a punishment mechanism to ensure the correct exercise of power, is key to punishing and preventing corruption. Effective punishment can enhance the persuasiveness of education, the binding force of systems, and the deterrent effect of supervision. Courts at all levels should fully understand the importance and necessity of investigating and handling cases under the new situation, and with a more resolute attitude, more powerful measures, and more solid work, always maintain a strong momentum in punishing corruption.

1. Problems such as a small number of leading cadres and a few judicial police using adjudication and enforcement powers to solicit and accept bribes, engage in malpractice for personal gain, pervert the law in judgment, and illegally enforce should be the focus of case investigation and handling. Serious investigation and handling should be carried out for leading cadres who violate political discipline, organizational personnel discipline, and financial discipline, illegally accept property, engage in morally degenerate lifestyles, and indulge or connive at spouses and children using their powers and positions to seek personal gain. Efforts should be made to break through a number of major and important cases with strong public reaction and serious social impact.

2. Discipline inspection and supervision departments should strengthen coordination and cooperation with petition, case filing, trial supervision, and case evaluation departments, broaden the channels for obtaining case leads, and continuously improve their ability to discover case leads on their own and their ability to independently break through cases, so that disciplinary and legal violations within people's courts can be discovered early, corrected early, and dealt with early.

3. Higher people's courts should strengthen supervision and guidance over the case investigation and handling work of lower people's courts. When necessary, they can uniformly deploy the strength of discipline inspection and supervision departments of lower people's courts to concentrate on investigating and handling some important cases, in order to solve the problems of insufficient case handling strength in discipline inspection and supervision departments of grassroots people's courts and the long-term inability to open up the work situation of case handling in some grassroots courts.

4. The assessment and evaluation mechanism for discipline inspection and supervision work should be improved. Units that can proactively discover and investigate problems should be affirmed and commended; for those units that have cases but do not investigate, or conceal cases and do not report, once discovered, their qualification for evaluation as advanced should be revoked. If the circumstances are serious, the leading responsibility should also be pursued according to discipline and law.

VI. Unremittingly Implement the Responsibility System for Improving Party Conduct and Integrity

The main leading cadres of people's courts at all levels must assume the political responsibility of being the "first responsible person" for anti-corruption construction in their units, incorporate the construction of Party conduct, integrity, and anti-corruption work into the overall work plan of their units, consider it comprehensively, coordinate its promotion, so that the duties of improving Party conduct and integrity extend wherever the limits of work authority reach. They should effectively achieve personally deploying important work, personally inquiring about major issues, personally coordinating key links, and personally supervising important cases. Closely focusing on the outstanding issues in the construction of Party conduct and integrity in people's courts, key links such as responsibility decomposition, responsibility assessment, and responsibility investigation should be grasped, so as to truly achieve clear responsibilities, assessed in place, and investigated effectively.

1. Courts at all levels should, in light of their own actual conditions, carefully study and determine the key tasks for improving Party conduct, integrity, and anti-corruption work in their units, and according to the functions of relevant departments and the post responsibilities of leading cadres, reasonably decompose the key tasks to the relevant functional departments and each member of the leading body, refine work responsibilities, implement the responsible subjects, clarify work objectives and work requirements, so that the division of tasks is specific, responsibilities are clearly delineated, responsibility requirements are clear, and safeguard measures are strong, so that every leading cadre knows their tasks, understands their responsibilities, exerts their efforts, and fulfills their duties, forming a strong work synergy.

2. The Party group of a people's court at each level shall conduct an annual assessment of the implementation of the responsibility system by the next-level leading body and its principal responsible person, as well as by the deputy heads of the leading body at the same level. Before the assessment, the assessment plan should be carefully studied and formulated. During the assessment, procedures should be strictly followed and standards should be adhered to, striving to make the assessment results objectively reflect the actual situation. After the assessment, in addition to promptly notifying the assessment results, the assessment results should be incorporated into the comprehensive assessment and evaluation system for leading bodies and leading cadres, and directly linked to the performance evaluation, rewards and punishments, and selection and appointment of leading cadres, forming an incentive mechanism for assessment and evaluation of the implementation of the responsibility system.

3. For leading cadres who are seriously derelict or negligent in implementing the responsibility system for improving Party conduct and integrity, regardless of whether they are currently in office or have been transferred or promoted, they shall be investigated. Both disciplinary sanctions and organizational measures should be comprehensively used to seriously pursue responsibility, and organizational measures should be intensified, resolutely removing from leading positions those leading cadres who are irresponsible and cause major problems; those who constitute disciplinary or legal violations should be resolutely investigated and dealt with severely. The Party groups of people's courts at all levels should clearly support the work of responsibility investigation.

People's courts at all levels should regard the implementation of the above opinions as an important task to solve outstanding problems in the study and practice of the Scientific Outlook on Development. From the perspective that judicial integrity issues concern the rise and fall of the people's judicial cause, the judicial credibility of people's courts, and social fairness and justice, they should deeply understand the long-term, complex, and arduous nature of the anti-corruption struggle within the people's courts themselves, further enhance their sense of urgency and responsibility, truly place the anti-corruption construction of people's courts in a more prominent position to grasp, tighten, and do a good job, and enhance the judicial credibility of people's courts with concrete actions of fairness, efficiency, and integrity, shaping a good image of the people's courts in the hearts of the people.
